# Origin of the MCP SDK wheel closure

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk (the official MCP Python SDK) and PyPI |
| Root requirement | `mcp==2.3.0` |
| Target | CPython 3.13.16, Windows x64 (`thirdparty/cpython/`): `implementation_name` = `cpython`, `implementation_version` = `3.13.16`, `os_name` = `nt`, `platform_machine` = `AMD64`, `platform_python_implementation` = `CPython`, `platform_release` = `10`, `platform_system` = `Windows`, `platform_version` = `10.0.26200`, `python_full_version` = `3.13.16`, `python_version` = `3.13`, `sys_platform` = `win32` |
| Resolved with | `python -m pip download mcp==2.3.0 --only-binary=:all: --platform win_amd64 --python-version 3.13 --implementation cp --abi cp313 --abi abi3 --abi none -d <dir>` (pip is unsupported in the embeddable package; the resolution is pinned below and re-checked by `closure_problems`) |
| Retrieved | 2026-10-10 |
| Importer | Rulebook task `phase0.7_toolchain-cpython`, run with `python -m tools.vendoring.wheels import` for UzmiGames |
| Distribution role | shipped: unpacked into `Lib\site-packages\` beside `UzPainter.exe` by `zig build painter`, without console scripts (`<name>.data/scripts/`) and without `pythonwin/` (Pythonwin, pywin32's GUI IDE: `Pythonwin.exe`, `win32ui.pyd`, `win32uiole.pyd` and `dde.pyd` import the MFC runtime `mfc140u.dll`, which is not shipped (measured with `tools.toolchain.dll_closure`), so they could not load on a clean machine; the MCP SDK does not use them); `adodbapi/` (pywin32's ADO database package, the one LGPL-2.1 component of the closure; the MCP SDK does not use it); the wheels themselves are build inputs |

Every wheel is byte-equal to the PyPI file at its URL (`MANIFEST.json`, `tools/vendoring/wheels.py`). Licence and notice files are the ones each wheel carries in `<dist-info>/licenses/`; they are installed with the wheel.

## Licence inventory

- Status: **release blocker** — RB-WHEEL-NATIVE-NOTICES: a native extension may contain statically linked third-party code (Rust crates, C libraries) that its wheel does not enumerate; those notices are collected for the release `NOTICE` (`phase5.2_packaging`) before a release (wheels: `cffi`, `cryptography`, `pydantic_core`, `rpds_py`)
- Every other wheel: confirmed against the pinned file (licence metadata, licence and notice files, hash).

## Notes

- `cryptography`: Stable-ABI wheel (`cp311-abi3`): its extension imports `python3.dll` of the embeddable package. cryptography's installation documentation states that its wheels statically link OpenSSL.
- `pywin32`: `mcp` requires it on Windows (`pywin32>=311; sys_platform == "win32"`); its `pywin32.pth` adds `win32`, `win32\lib` and `Pythonwin` to `sys.path` and loads `pywin32_system32`, so the interpreter imports `site` (`src/python/python313._pth`).
- `pywin32`: `pythonwin/` and `adodbapi/` are not installed (`NOT_INSTALLED`), so no LGPL-2.1 code and no binary needing the MFC runtime ships; their licence texts stay in the installed `dist-info/licenses/`.
